editorial.blurb: Minyoli brings authentic Taiwanese flavors and thoughtful cocktails to Chicago, with standout house-made noodles and tender braised beef that keeps guests coming back.
editorial.insiderTip: Order the beef noodle soup with tendons during lunch for specials and no wait, then ask staff for cocktail recommendations—the mixologist creates complex drinks celebrating Taiwanese ingredients like sour plum and Hawthorne berry.
signatureDishes: Red-braised Niuroumian Soup Noodles (beef noodle soup)
